2. Filter for transactions with "paid" status (including 'paid', 'PAID', and 'settled')
3. Handle corrections (when an ID appears multiple times, use the LAST one)
4. Convert all amounts to USD (1 EUR = 1.052 USD)
5. Calculate the average
